title: Embedding a halted run at rewind
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $x$ be a Boolean input. Take an augmented configuration $D$, an index $j$ with $0\le j\le r$, a counter $c$ with $0\le c\le r+1$, and a configuration $u$ of $N$ on $x$. If $u$ is halted and every tape block of $D$ with index greater than $j$ is blank with its head at cell $0$, then embedding $u$ into block $j$ at counter $c$ produces an augmented configuration in rewind phase at index $j$. Its counter is increased by one, capped at $r+1$, exactly when the summary of $u$'s output is true; its output is empty, and every block with index greater than $j$ remains blank with its head at cell $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Blocks of $D$ with index greater than $j$ are blank and have head position $0$
